# Error codes

<!-- Generated by packages/mongoshield/scripts/generate-error-docs.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every MongoShield failure is a `MongoShieldError` with a stable `code`. The CLI exits with
the code's exit status, so scripts can react to specific failures.

```ts
import { isMongoShieldError } from "mongoshield";

try {
  await shield.backup();
} catch (error) {
  if (isMongoShieldError(error, "MS_STORAGE_FORBIDDEN")) {
    // fix credentials
  }
}
```

| Code | Exit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| [`MS_CONFIG_INVALID`](#ms_config_invalid) | 2 | The configuration is invalid. |
| [`MS_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`](#ms_confirmation_required) | 3 | A destructive action needs confirmation, but the session is not interactive. Re-run with --yes. |
| [`MS_CONNECTION_FAILED`](#ms_connection_failed) | 10 | Could not connect to MongoDB. |
| [`MS_AUTH_FAILED`](#ms_auth_failed) | 11 | MongoDB rejected the credentials. |
| [`MS_PERMISSION_DENIED`](#ms_permission_denied) | 12 | The MongoDB user lacks a privilege this operation needs. |
| [`MS_UNSUPPORTED_TOPOLOGY`](#ms_unsupported_topology) | 13 | The deployment topology does not support this operation. |
| [`MS_SNAPSHOT_TOO_OLD`](#ms_snapshot_too_old) | 14 | A snapshot backup took longer than the server keeps snapshot history (5 minutes by default). |
| [`MS_CHANGE_HISTORY_LOST`](#ms_change_history_lost) | 15 | Changes needed for consistency or point-in-time recovery are no longer in the oplog (it rolled over). |
| [`MS_STORAGE_NOT_FOUND`](#ms_storage_not_found) | 20 | The storage location or object does not exist. |
| [`MS_STORAGE_FORBIDDEN`](#ms_storage_forbidden) | 21 | Access to the storage location was denied. |
| [`MS_STORAGE_IO`](#ms_storage_io) | 22 | A storage read or write failed. |
| [`MS_STORAGE_INSUFFICIENT_SPACE`](#ms_storage_insufficient_space) | 23 | There is not enough space at the storage location. |
| [`MS_STORAGE_PRECONDITION_FAILED`](#ms_storage_precondition_failed) | 24 | A conditional storage write failed because the object already exists. |
| [`MS_BACKUP_NOT_FOUND`](#ms_backup_not_found) | 30 | No backup matches the given selector. |
| [`MS_MANIFEST_INVALID`](#ms_manifest_invalid) | 31 | A backup manifest is missing or malformed. |
| [`MS_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED`](#ms_format_unsupported) | 32 | The backup uses a format version this release cannot read. |
| [`MS_INTEGRITY_FAILED`](#ms_integrity_failed) | 33 | Backup data failed an integrity check (checksum, size or count). |
| [`MS_GUARD_FAILED`](#ms_guard_failed) | 34 | The backup guard refused a backup that looks like data was lost since the previous one. |
| [`MS_BACKUP_PROTECTED`](#ms_backup_protected) | 35 | The backup cannot be deleted: it is on hold, under an object lock, or other backups depend on it. |
| [`MS_ENCRYPTION_FAILED`](#ms_encryption_failed) | 40 | Encrypting backup data failed. |
| [`MS_DECRYPTION_FAILED`](#ms_decryption_failed) | 41 | Backup data could not be decrypted or failed authentication. |
| [`MS_NO_IDENTITY`](#ms_no_identity) | 42 | The backup is encrypted and no matching identity or passphrase was given. |
| [`MS_RESTORE_CONFLICT`](#ms_restore_conflict) | 50 | The restore target already contains data that would be overwritten. |
| [`MS_RESTORE_FAILED`](#ms_restore_failed) | 51 | Writing documents to the target failed. |
| [`MS_ABORTED`](#ms_aborted) | 60 | The operation was aborted. |
| [`MS_TIMEOUT`](#ms_timeout) | 61 | The operation timed out. |
| [`MS_NOT_IMPLEMENTED`](#ms_not_implemented) | 70 | This feature is not implemented yet. |
| [`MS_INTERNAL`](#ms_internal) | 71 | An unexpected internal error occurred. |

## ms_config_invalid

**`MS_CONFIG_INVALID`** · exit code 2
